notes.title: Last Patch
notes.content: All of the armors are now up to date with names and descriptions. We are also working on our new game, 'Golden Castle'. Also we have a discord if you wish to join us there.

notes.title: Update for Bug Fixes and More...
notes.content:
So there are a lot of bug fixes in this update.

Also you will notice that more equipment, items, spells, and skills have names and descriptions.

Also there is now some lore in the towns and even in some of the shrines (not all of the shrines). Also more items in the towns to get from houses.

Level cap has been changed to 30. Bosses are hard coded to now have a minimum level and maximum level.

notes.title: Upcoming Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm working on fixing quite a number of bugs/issues with the game so the next update won't be out until 9/15. This is so I have time to make sure that everything is working that I am working on. This is also ahead of the sale that is happening on the 16th that the game will be participating in. I want to make this game more enjoyable for all of you so please just be patient with me a while longer while I work on fixing these bug/issues with the game as I am just one person. 

Also even after this update comes out, please continue to report any issues/bugs you find with the game so that I can fix them in a timely manner or at least try my best to.

notes.title: Cyna Bug Update
notes.content:
You can now leave the Dwarven area and continue on with the game. Sorry for taking so long with the update.

Working on fixing other things in the background as well and hoping to have other fixes/updates out before the 9/16/24.

notes.title: Fixed Bugs and Updated Stuff
notes.content:
Fixed some bugs pointed out by players and updated some small stuff.

Still working on armor names and descriptions.

notes.title: Updated Cyna's quest
notes.content:
Updated Cyna's quest slightly and moved some things around in the Fiery Cavern.

Thanks again for your continued support.

Remember I'm just one person.

notes.title: Small Bug Fix
notes.content: Small bug fix as a player alerted me to some bugs in the game, so this is just an update to fix those bugs.

notes.content:
Just an update to all of the NPC sprites as the last update I had made them all a bit to big, so I have now changed them all.

Still working on the armor names and descriptions, same with spell descriptions.

Same with more lore tidbits to be added in.

The last update had a small issue.

Sorry, the last update might have had an issue of not running. This one should work now.

Remember, I'm a team of 1.

notes.title: Update Live!
notes.content:
Just a small update, hopefully it works. Just an update in encounter steps, now they are set to 40. The item and weapon descriptions are also live. 

Working next on armor names, and descriptions followed by spell/skill descriptions. 

Then working on placing some more tid bits of lore around.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.

Please remember I'm a team of 1.

notes.title: Item and Weapon Descriptions
notes.content:
We have just updated the descriptions of some of the key items along with all of the weapon descriptions in the game. 

The next thing we will be working on is updating the names and descriptions of the armors in the game. 

Thank you all for all of your continued support for our game.

notes.title: Corrupted Spirits Released Finally
notes.content:
Corrupted Spirits has finally released. Yes, its a little behind schedule, but it has finally released. Please let us know if you run into any bugs or errors when playing the game and we will try to fix them. Also we are aware of some of the armor not having actual names along with skill/items not having descriptions, we are working on this. The main thing we wanted was to get the game out to all of you, so have fun and let us know how you like the game.

notes.title: Overview and Announcement Video
notes.content: [previewyoutube=uaqUdg5Y9oo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube] Here is everything that we are working on along with a brief summary of where you can play until in the demo. Also explains some of the games features in a bit better detail. Please continue to support and be patient with us.

notes.title: Release Date - Pushed Back
notes.content:
Sad day it is when the release date of a game has to be pushed back. 

I know that some of you were waiting on the release of this title as I do watch to see the number of people wishlisting the game rise. Sadly, we are currently a one-person company so when real life happens to get in the way sometimes the release date happens to get pushed back. I know that right now it just says Q2 for the release date but we/I am hard at work on the game. I'm not going to rush it though, because I still want to deliver a game worth playing. I just hope you can be patient with us a bit longer as we work on this.

notes.title: Enemy Encounters
notes.content: The demo was just updated so the the encounter rate was lessened. You now have to take 40 steps instead of the preset 30 steps to run into enemies on the 2 maps that have enemies. I hope that helps with the enemy encounters. Please let us know of any other issues the demo has as we work on the rest of the game for the end of the month release.
